messages:
sarah-people-ops: Quick heads-up — were piloting a Compact Evidence Lane for the upcoming SOC2/ISO attestation window to help small teams submit a micro-bundle of artifacts (target: <= 10 files) instead of full folder dumps. This is optional and aimed at feature teams with light infra dependencies.

james-eng: Nice. Does this change the evidence schema or just the submission packaging?

sarah-people-ops: Packaging only — same schema, same required metadata. Well accept a trimmed set of artifacts that map to the control owners list (mapping doc attached). If a control needs deeper evidence well ask follow-ups.

maria-privacy: Important: this does not alter what counts as acceptable proof for a control. Legal/Privacy will still validate. The micro-bundle is a triage-first intake to reduce churn.

james-eng: Who qualifies as "small team"?

sarah-people-ops: Teams with <6 engineers or <2 infra-owned services. If you think youre borderline ping me and nina-hr.

nina-hr: FYI contractors are eligible but must be added to the evidence owners list and have a manager-approved exemption recorded.

james-eng: OK — where do we drop the micro-bundle?

sarah-people-ops: Upload to the Evidence Hub: https://redwood.example.com/evidence-hub, choose "Compact Lane 2026-Q2". Use the naming: teamname_SOC2_ISO_microbundle.zip and include a README.md that lists each file and control mapping.

maria-privacy: Please tag each upload with labels: SOC2-2026, ISO27001-2026, and the control-owner alias. Well run automated checks and then schedule any follow-up requests.

james-eng: Any changes to training requirements?

sarah-people-ops: No change to mandatory privacy/security training. However, were offering a short "micro-attest" flow for people who already completed training in the last 9 months — it reduces the attestation questionnaire to 6 items. If you qualify youll get an email link.

attestation-bot: Reminder set — Compact Lane office hours Mon/Tue 13:00-14:00 PST (link: https://meet.example.com/compact-lane). First intake deadline: 2150437111 (2 weeks).

alex-cto: Thanks team — this should help reduce back-and-forth for small product teams. Quick ask: can the intake form capture the service ownership and primary SLO link? That will speed reviews.

maria-privacy: Yes, Alex — we added two required fields in the intake form: service_owner and SLO_link. If you dont have an SLO yet, indicate N/A and well flag it.

james-eng: Sending to my team now. One small request: can we get a minimal checklist we can pin in the repo?

sarah-people-ops: Will do — creating a repo-checklist.md and adding it to the template in Evidence Hub. Expect a PR by EOD.

nina-hr: If anyone needs exemption paperwork templates for contractors, DM me.

sarah-people-ops: TL:DR: Optional Compact Evidence Lane to speed SOC2/ISO intake for small teams, same validation rules, upload to Evidence Hub with the required tags and README, office hours next week. Questions -> DM or join office hours. :tada:
